results.content: ## The cost of living tops Americans' concerns, while the president's approval ratings sit at 40%, Supreme Court's at 47%, congressional GOP at 37% and congressional Dems at 34%, new poll says. Inflation and the cost of living are the most important issues to Americans, while more adults disapprove than approve of the Supreme Court, the president and both parties in Congress, according to a new Marquette Law School Poll. The poll, conducted from July 22 through July 29 by SSRS of U.S. adults, reported that 35% of people ranked inflation and the cost of living as the most important issue to them personally.
